name: Yo
description: Ask @yo how to do an ep0ch thing: two lines quoted from the action's own doc, and a button.

answer.description: The command that picks what an ask is about: prompt on stdin, JSON on stdout; empty, yo quotes its closest match with no model

act.description: The command that fills in an action yo will press: yo's code steps up to it once on an act; empty, yo only offers the button

memory.description: Where yo keeps what worked: an outline by name, on a machine (an ssh name) when it isn't here; empty, this outline

ep0ch.description: The command yo reads actions and docs through; left out, this checkout's door, else ep0ch on the PATH

actions.label: Remember that this answer worked
actions.description: A button yo drew runs this after its action: one memory note in yo's memory outline

args.name: args
args.label: Arguments
args.description: The arguments that worked, as on:false,reach:full

agents.name: yo
agents.description: Answers how to do an ep0ch thing from the actions' own docs, and presses it when asked
